title: Article Visual Search
short: I independently built an interactive map of scientific literature from PubMed and Semantic Scholar, combining embeddings and clustering with optional LLM-generated cluster summaries. Developed intermittently from May 2023 to March 2026, it follows my earlier work on mapping document collections.

title: Baysor & spatial transcriptomics
short: As lead author and maintainer of Baysor, I develop Bayesian cell-segmentation methods and reproducible research software. My related work with Altos Labs examined how segmentation errors affect spatial analysis, leading to a co-first-author Nature Genetics paper in 2026.

title: GPTCellAnnotator
short: Built an LLM-assisted workflow for single-cell cluster annotation in 2023–2024. GPT proposes candidate cell types and markers; Scanpy identifies cluster markers, and GPT assigns labels from that evidence.

title: Modular neural networks
short: With an AI Safety Camp team, explored loss-function regularisation to encourage modular structure in neural networks, demonstrating the approach on an MLP and word2vec.
long: I extended Graph Spectral Regularization to impose arbitrary target graph structures and used it to organise word2vec neurons into five modules, enabling visual inspection of the resulting embeddings.
